title: Pan-Seared Brussels Sprouts Braise
description: A hearty, comforting side dish that combines the earthy sweetness of Brussels sprouts with the rich flavor of a Ukrainian-inspired braise.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Brussels sprouts and cook for 5 minutes, until they are browned and tender.
Add the beef broth, salt, and pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, until the sprouts are very tender.
Stir in the red wine vinegar and cook for 1 minute, until heated through.
Serve the sprouts hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
